products.title: Interplay Between High Step and Body Lock Passing by Nicky Ryan
products.body:
Nicky Ryan Presents A Game-Changing Passing System That Blends High Step and Body Lock Passing Into An Unstoppable Strategy That Anyone Can Learn!

  • Develop your passing game in real-time with Nicky Ryan as he guides you through the intricacies of body lock passing, forcing half guard, half guard passing, and how high step passing ties it all together.
  • Uncover unique ways to force half guard on opponents and drastically reduce their offensive abilities!
  • Master crippling controls from the top to keep opponents pinned to the mat and more vulnerable for high-percentage passes from body lock and half guard situations.
  • Build a diverse passing system as Nicky provides multiple variations for each pass that allow you to always stay a step ahead.
  • Discover how high step passing plays an integral role in tying the passing system together by offering you the ability to outflank and outmaneuver even the most flexible guards.
  • Overhaul your passing with World-Class competitor and Coach Nicky Ryan and his 5-part series Interplay Between High step and Body Lock Passing!

products.title: Systematically Attacking the Guard Body Lock Study by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
This is your chance to learn from 3-Time ADCC Champion Gordon Ryan as he shares all his competition secrets around the body lock

  • Gordon is one of the most detailed and thorough teachers in grappling, with incredible systematic attention to detail.
  • Use front body locks, side body locks, tightwaists, over under body locks, and more to smash through the guard using Gordon’s advice.
  • Learn what the “Golden Trilemma” is - and how you can use it to create an unstoppable passing threat.
  • These are the same systems that Gordon uses to pass against elite competition, including leg pummeling, half guard passing, high tripods, and more.
  • Watch as Gordon rolls in the gym from these same systems and then breaks down the footage to explain the techniques in action.

Get A Lock On Your Opponent And Shut Down Their Guard With Gordon Ryan’s 10-Volume Study Of The Body Lock - With Every Technique, Strategy, & System You Need To Succeed With This No-Gi Grappling Passing Attack!


Check Out Sample!

What Will You Learn?

Break down the art and science of body lock guard passing with Gordon “The King” Ryan as he shows how to use this effective system to shut down and dominate bottom players in no-gi grappling. With 10 volumes packed with instructional content and rolling breakdowns, this series shows every detail of Gordon’s system for using body locks successfully at the highest levels of the spot.

Gordon Ryan is one of the best no-gi grapplers in history, and is still building his legacy with a path of submission success. With 3 ADCC World Championships & an IBJJF World No-Gi Championship, he has charted a path of success built on technical precision and strategic strength - with body lock passing as one of the keys to his next level guard passing. Now you can learn how to enter the body lock, when and how to use them, and how to systematically work through the guard using these techniques for passing success.

Combine body locks from the side, front, outside, and more positions to create strong passing attacks as you see the cues for entering and moving between each. Split the legs and force your way into half guard passing, high tripod passing, leg pummeling, and more strong sub-systems that Gordon breaks down - including the “Golden Trilemma” that will change the way you pressure pass in no-gi.

Play from seated and supine open guards like butterfly, reverse de la riva, shin to shin, and more as Nicky shows you a complete system for using wrestle up sweeps to your advantage

  • Create strong attacks using double kouchi, arm drags, front headlocks, and more of Nicky’s signature competition offense
  • Nicky is an elite black belt competitor & B-Team founder who is one of the most technical grapplers on Earth, regardless of size
  • Learn how to wrestle up using double legs, single legs, ankle picks, and more that Nicky has specialized for submission grappling success
  • This is an open guard blueprint that anyone can use for grappling success in no-gi Brazilian jiu-jitsu, explained in extreme detail by one of the best

Wrestle Your Way Up From The Guard With B-Team Founder Nicky Ryan’s System For Using Wrestling-Style Sweeps For No-Gi Success! Learn How To Be Effective From Your Open Guard With These Modern Techniques From Bottom!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

 Learn one of the most successful open guard sweeping systems in modern grappling with Nicky Ryan’s debut BJJ Fanatics instructional series on how to wrestle up from the bottom position. Use singles, doubles, ankle picks, body locks, and more as Nicky shows you every detail you’ll need to start scoring reversals and being effective from bottom position in this 3-part series.

Work from common no-gi grappling guards like seated, shin to shin, reverse De La Riva, and more as Nicky explains how to construct a strong systematic attack. Use off balances, grip fighting, and high percentage sweeping attacks like the sumi gaeshi, arm drag, single leg, and front headlock to constantly threaten from bottom position - all with Nicky Ryan’s advice on these topics he has mastered.

Nicky Ryan is one of the most technical black belts on Earth, and sets himself apart as an athlete and instructor with his attention to detail. Even champion black belts seek out his technical and systematic advice! Now is your chance to learn from this young prodigy grappler as he explains one of the strongest parts of his game.

Start wrestling your way up from bottom, no wrestling or takedown experience necessary, using this guide from an elite competitor with Nicky Ryan’s coaching. This system works together to create the strongest possible threat from bottom position, and now you can improve your no-gi guard with help from one of the best.
